title: Penthouse Magazine July 2001 Alex Arden Blink-182 Vintage
descriptionText:
Penthouse magazine, July 2001 issue, cover model Alex Arden. Features Blink-182 ("Lords of Flatulence"), plus culture/politics content (polio-vaccine cancer investigation, wrestling gimmicks, interviews with George Plimpton, Rob Zombie, Rev. Al Sharpton, and Steve Nash).
Complete issue, no missing pages noted. Ships discreetly in a plain wrapper/sleeve.
Adult content — buyer must be 18+.
